_comment: Wowza SecureToken v2 specification, derived entirely from www.camaramar.com.har
and www.camaramar.com2.har. Every field below is observed in the captures, not
assumed. This is the complete token format -- with one field the captures cannot
supply: shared_secret. That value exists only server-side (the site signs URLs in
Laravel and ships the finished string), and a SHA-256 digest does not leak its
input, so it is not recoverable from any capture. Supply it yourself via --secret.

edge._note: Server header is stripped -- no version disclosure in the capture.

content._note: content_path is <application>/<streamname>: no leading slash, no filename.

token.url_encoding: the trailing '=' is percent-encoded as %3D in the query string
_client_ip_note: Only three params appear, but SecureTokenIncludeClientIPInHash=true folds the
client IP into the digest WITHOUT adding a param -- so the capture can neither
confirm nor rule this out. If hashes never match with a known-good secret, retry

delivery.signed_url_source: server-rendered HTML attribute data-stream-src on the <video> element
_client_side_evidence: No occurrence of sha256, subtle.digest, CryptoJS, hmac, secureToken, sharedSecret,
or the token prefix in app.b1578b99.js, video8.js, or livewire.js. The only crypto
matches across the capture were Google Tag Manager, gtag, and Clarity.

token_propagation.mechanism: Wowza rewrites derived URIs to carry the token base64-embedded after '_tk' in the FILENAME, not as query params
token_propagation._verified: All 6 derived requests in the capture decode to exactly the same 3 params as the parent playlist query.
